verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a banking-as-a-service platform like Synctera, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of selectable storage regions or residency controls. The 'US based accounts' wording for domestic wires describes payment rails, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
